02 /THE PERSON BEHIND THE PIXELS

Hi, I'm Natasya.
Nice to meet you.

I'm an Informatics Engineering student from Indonesia, now studying Software Engineering at Nanjing Xiaozhuang University in China.

I like making complex things feel simple. Sometimes that means building a web app. Sometimes it's refining a Figma prototype, presenting a robotics project, or figuring out a new language.

Outside the screen? You'll find me exploring new ideas, following the Indonesian stock market, and connecting with people from different backgrounds.
